ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: What stresses characters and how fast they calm down, and what the HUD shows. Hunger and thirst are set in the Server panel.
ADMIN_C_STRESS_DESC: Shooting and fast driving add stress; it fades over time.
ADMIN_C_SHOW_DESC: Parts of the HUD players see while playing.
ADMIN_H_STRESS_SPEED: Driving faster than this may add a stress point. 0 turns it off.
ADMIN_H_STRESS_SPEED_CHANCE: Chance per speed change above the stress speed to add a point.
ADMIN_H_STRESS_SHOT: Points a shot adds, at most once a second. 0 turns it off.
ADMIN_H_STRESS_RELIEF: Stress points that fade every minute. Shooting and fast driving add stress.
ADMIN_H_SHOW_IDENTITY: Top right: the job, its grade, the server id and the character name.
ADMIN_C_MAP_KEYS_DESC: When the minimap shows and the key list on the left of the screen.
ADMIN_H_MINIMAP: Always, or only while in a vehicle. Players can still turn it on for themselves in /hud.
ADMIN_H_MINIMAP_ZOOM: How far the minimap zooms in while in a vehicle (higher shows less around you, 1100 is close). 0 keeps the game's own zoom.
ADMIN_H_WAYPOINT_CUSTOM: Paint the map waypoint and its route in the colour below. Off gives the game's purple back.
ADMIN_H_KEY_HINTS: The keys of what the player can do now (on foot, in a vehicle) on the left of the screen. Which keys show, and when, is set per key in the Server panel's Keybinds tab.
